brand.name: Terra Nova
brand.description: Manufactured by Arnold André Dominicana S.R.L.; distributed in the U.S. by United Cigars/Two Guys Cigars per a January 2022 distribution deal.

line.name: Araperique
line.filler: Includes Araperique tobacco (a rare varietal, barrel-aged in oak whiskey casks) plus other Dominican filler tobaccos
line.notes: Flavor notes: pepper, floral, hay, cedar, cinnamon, peanuts, fruit zest, butter, fig, dark chocolate, oak.

line.name: Dark Fired Kentucky
line.filler: Dominican, Nicaraguan, Brazilian tobaccos plus Dark Fired Kentucky leaf
line.notes: 20-count boxes. Cigar Coop rated the Toro 88 pts. A 5th size, Churchill (6.75x50), is documented by some retailers but not present in our photo library.

research_notes: Terra Nova is technically an Arnold André house brand distributed (not manufactured) by United Cigars - worth noting for database categorization/attribution.
